title: Norwegian Escapade: Fjords and Northern Lights
alt: Green northern lights over a snow-covered fjord outside Tromsø

expert.name: Ingrid
expert.quote: For the northern lights you need three things: darkness, a clear sky and patience. Tromsø gives you the first two; we build in the third.
expert.tip: Book the aurora chase for your first night in the north, not the last. If the sky stays cloudy, most operators let you join again free of charge.

summary: Eight days from the capital to the Arctic: Oslo with a city pass, the Norway in a Nutshell route to Bergen and a fjord cruise, then three nights in Tromsø for reindeer sledding and a guided northern lights chase.
